_comment: The government record lists an RSRA searches, the distance each is searched, and where each distance comes from. The search distance used is the LARGER of the 40 CFR 312.26(c) distance and the ASTM E1527-21 Table 1 distance. Distances are measured from the subject parcel boundary, as 312.26(d) specifies. 'adjoining' is searched as 1/8 mile from the boundary, which reaches across a public street to the properties ASTM calls adjoining; the EP may change any distance under 312.26(d) and must document why.

citations.astm: ASTM E1527-21 section 8.2.1, Table 1 (Standard Environmental Record Sources and approximate minimum search distance), as commonly reproduced in Phase I reports
citations.sba: SBA SOP 50 10 8 and Procedural Notice 5000-866054 (2025-03-20): an RSRA searches the databases an AAI-compliant Phase I searches
